verdict.rationale: Missive mentions "AI rules" alongside its rules engine, and its changelog describes letting an agent triage new conversations against your CRM, so some AI-driven triage exists. Auditability is supported by the assistant session tab showing what the assistant is doing and by logging of every action. However, the evidence never documents how AI rules auto-label, categorize, or prioritize mail, and the triage example depends on an external agent connecting over MCP. Missing for 10: documented AI auto-labeling/categorization behavior, built-in surfacing of what needs attention, detail on how users steer AI rule behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
